facts.text: Wilderness car park, Wetherby (PayByPhone zone 811527) charges Monday to Saturday, 8am to 6pm: up to 1 hour free, up to 2 hours £1.15, up to 3 hours £2.15, up to 5 hours £2.65, up to 6 hours £3.15, up to 10 hours £3.65, up to 7 days £12.15. Sunday is free all day. Maximum stay 23 hours. The council's page does not mention the bathing site.
The site is reached from the Wilderness car park. It runs either side of Wetherby Bridge, from below the weir to the bandstand and picnic area just west of the car park.
Defra's February 2024 designation consultation listed public toilets among the facilities near the site. It did not say where. This is a 2024 listing, not a current check.
